provenance: authored application of the minimal record to wholly synthetic facts; no independent evaluator or actual decision change

handoffs.decision: proceed with one bounded pilot; defer platform
handoffs.evidence_status: Fictional reported problem plus refundable deposit; no retained payment or completed delivery.
handoffs.offer: One monthly report, one export, one revision; integrations excluded.
handoffs.contradiction: Platform build would exceed what the deposit tests. Deposit must remain distinguishable from final payment.
handoffs.handoff_question: Can one eight-hour delivery fit the sixteen-hour limit without extra integrations or revisions?
handoffs.gate: Deliver only one pilot; inspect actual time, acceptance, refund/final payment and changed scope before a second commitment.
handoffs.change_trigger: New source format, integration or revision requirement invalidates delivery estimate and quote.

handoffs.decision: revise to bounded workshop hypothesis; defer full course
handoffs.evidence_status: Fictional preference only; no payment or learning outcome.
handoffs.offer: Replace the unlimited course/feedback idea with one two-hour workshop, six seats and one bounded exercise.
handoffs.contradiction: Eighteen compliments neither fund the twenty-three-seat course break-even nor establish willingness to pay.
handoffs.handoff_question: Define a paid presale test for the bounded workshop, including refunds and a four-seat minimum before fixed spend.
handoffs.gate: No course production; workshop only if the specified retained-payment threshold, cost cap and owner authorization hold; otherwise stop or report inconclusive exposure.
handoffs.change_trigger: Changed seat price, feedback scope or delivery hours requires a new economics record.

handoffs.evidence_status: Fictional paid subscriptions show price acceptance, not viable delivery.
handoffs.offer: Current $100 monthly service includes the assumed hour of support.
handoffs.contradiction: Recurring cost is $120 per subscriber; additional identical subscribers increase the modeled loss.
handoffs.handoff_question: Is there independently supported different scope, cost structure or price that removes the recurring loss?
handoffs.gate: Stop the current offer and expansion. No finite fixed-cost break-even exists at negative contribution. Reopen only with changed, evidenced assumptions and operator decision.
handoffs.change_trigger: A new price or reduced-support assumption is a new hypothesis, not a retroactive pass.

handoffs.decision: revise scope; reject custom proofing at unchanged price
handoffs.evidence_status: One fictional custom request; no agreed amended quote or completed batch.
handoffs.offer: Original standard item only, no three-proof customization; five-order pilot maximum.
handoffs.contradiction: Added proofing changes contribution from $3 to -$15 at the unchanged $45 price.
handoffs.handoff_question: Can the bounded original offer and exclusions be stated without promising the requested proofing?
handoffs.gate: Reject changed scope at old price. A five-order standard batch has modeled $65 setup loss within the fictional $100 cap; this is a bounded learning cost, not profitability.
handoffs.change_trigger: Any proofing, shipping, fees or labor change invalidates margin and capacity assumptions.

handoffs.decision: hold expansion; permit only one capacity-bounded follow-up proposal
handoffs.evidence_status: One fictional paid accepted delivery; another quote request, not renewal.
handoffs.offer: 3,000 words and one revision; no unlimited rework promise.
handoffs.contradiction: Including quality review raises hours from five to six and lowers modeled contribution; do not exclude that hour to preserve the forecast.
handoffs.handoff_question: Does a second same-scope job repeat accepted quality and delivery economics, and what explains rework?
handoffs.gate: One job fits the remaining ten-hour capacity; no expansion until delivery/rework and repeat-payment evidence exist.
handoffs.change_trigger: Further revisions or deadline changes require operational and pricing review before a new commitment.
